map.• 总电压 = 单体电压 × 串联数: • Total voltage = cell voltage × number in series

map.串联与并联分别决定什么？: What do series and parallel connection each determine?
map.串联决定电压（V串=V单体×N串），并联决定容量（Ah并=Ah单体×N并），总能: Series determines the voltage (V_series = V_cell × N_series) and parallel determines the capacity (Ah_parallel = Ah_cell × N_parallel), so total energy = Ah_parallel × V_series.
